source: Spec 124 R-DA, McBylaws INC-6 D7 (INC6-RECAP) recapture: every entry is a measured PRE->POST diff (teststack/compare.out, 18 differences) of docs/reports/golden/compute_maxbld_scenarios/post/standalone.json (committed POST at the tip vs the teststack capture of the tip + Part B patch), explained from the cited code line, migration, setting key or measured teststack value.

diffs.why: The row-7 audit value (inputs_nonempty) counts the Layer 2 results table: 125,426,505 in the inc-5 POST -> 127,626,970. records_new is the run's inserted-row count (ledger write scripts/lib/step/ledger.js:276 `records_new = $6`). The committed inc-5 POST is capture run 1 on a table of 293,913 rows (420,699 inserted, inc-5 teststack/cap.out:10 "records_new":420699). Here the table already holds all 624,325 rows from the inc-5 night, so the run inserts none: measured teststack/c3-runs.out "4466:1921|0|624325|completed" (run 4466 = first run after "pipeline_runs max(id) before = 4465", cap.out:7) and c3-rowcheck.out:1 "PASS: old 624325 new 624325; missing 0; added 0".

records_updated is the run's rewritten-row count (ledger write scripts/lib/step/ledger.js:276 `records_updated = $7`). Every one of the 624,325 existing rows is rewritten because its content_sha moved under the Part B engine with the lot stamp: teststack/c3-rowcheck.out:1 "old rows changed: sha 624325, value/unit 0, status 0, flags 0"; the stamp moved because layer2_table_version is copied from the lot (scripts/lib/compute/compute-maxbld-scenarios.js:394 `layer2_table_version: source.lot ? source.lot.table_version : null`) and the night reloaded the lots at 07bc0ba7b615 (ruling-2 correction, MORNING-DECISIONS.md:654-656: "every row carries the lots' night pair 07bc0ba7b615"; label-only, value/unit/status/flags unchanged). The rerun writes 0 (c3-runs.out "4467:1921|0|0|completed"). Inc-5 POST had 203,626 (cap.out:10).

stdout line 0 is the target banner (scripts/lib/resolve-db.js:285 `migrations=${migrationCount}...`) naming the test stack's applied-migration count: migrations=306 in the inc-5 POST, migrations=308 here, because this job applied two migrations: 329 (INC6-NIGHT Layer 2, NIGHT-RECORD.md:8) and 330 (the three Part B settings, migrations/330_layer3_increment6_settings.sql:1); measured teststack/job.log:23 "applied_329 = 1 (want 1)" and :25 "applied_330 = 1 (want 1)"; cap.out:5 "migrations=308 (floor 223)". Environment text, not step behaviour.
